content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (Article X(b), ¶p0125).**

- **Issue:** The non-solicit runs one way against us, lasts three years post-termination, and covers every employee of Licensor *and* all its Affiliates — beyond our walk-away thresholds (no >24 months; no coverage of all Vendor personnel).
- **Mitigating:** The clause already excludes general job advertising and voluntary/unsolicited inquiries, and contains no no-hire element, so only duration, mutuality and scope needed fixing.
- **Redline (fallback, validated ok:true):** mutual obligation, limited to personnel directly involved in performance, 12 months from the end of that involvement, existing carve-out preserved.
- **Noted but not redlined:** Article XI (¶p0126) grants injunctive relief for non-solicit breaches only to Licensor; can be mutualized if the counterparty accepts the mutual covenant.
